description: This file defines a React component 'TargetRoleDetailsPanel' that displays detailed information about a specific target role, including its attributes, associated report data, skills, responsibilities, and related insights. It also includes several utility functions for processing strings, skills, and scores.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, replacing nullish or undefined values with an empty string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts a value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into bulleted sentences, ensuring proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a numeric value between 0 and 100 and rounds it to the nearest integer.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates skills from persona object properties, handling schema variations.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes skill strings to lowercase trimmed versions for comparison.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds common skills between persona skills and required skills, respecting case-insensitive matching.
